# Rebar Robot Maintenance Checklist

Rebar Robot Maintenance Checklist — Working Note

Date: 2024-04-21  
From: Ephik, Field Tech Lead

Observations:  
- TieBot #7 has shown slight delay in tying cycle times over the past week; average cycle up from 12.3s to 13.1s. Suspected minor wear on wrist servo.  
- Battery health checks on all units show 87-92% capacity remaining after 150 charge cycles, within expected range but trending downward.  
- Cameras on TieBot #4 appear slightly fogged during morning shifts — possibly condensation inside housing. Need to inspect seals.  

Measurements:  
- Wrist servo torque output measured at 1.45 Nm on unit #7, down from 1.6 Nm baseline.  
- Dust accumulation inside unit #2’s ventilation grills measured ~0.8 mm layer — recommend more frequent filter swaps.  
- Battery charge time stable at ~110 minutes, no anomalies.  

Open Questions:  
- How often should we recalibrate the servo torque sensors? Currently doing it every 3 months, but maybe quarterly is too long?  
- Any updates on firmware patches addressing thermal regulation — overheating warnings popped up in the last firmware version.  

Next Steps:  
- Schedule servo replacement on unit #7 ahead of next project phase.  
- Replace camera seals on unit #4 and monitor for fogging next week.  
- Increase filter replacement frequency from biweekly to weekly for dusty sites.  
- Check in with firmware team about thermal regulation fixes and possible calibration intervals.
